# Rao's Consulting Engineers, LLC (RCE)

Texas Registered Engineering Firm F-17655 (TBPELS).

> Texas civil engineering firm providing land development, water resources,
> transportation, environmental, and permitting services. Headquartered in
> Cedar Park (Austin area), with a branch office in San Antonio.

## What we do
- Land development and site plans (commercial, retail, residential, multi-family)
- Water resources, drainage and detention design
- Transportation, driveway access and traffic studies
- Environmental, including TCEQ Edwards Aquifer protection plans (WPAP, CZP)
- Permitting with Texas cities, counties, TCEQ and TxDOT

## Where we work
Projects across Texas, centred on the Austin / Williamson County area and the
San Antonio area.
